svg.desc: Hunain Ahmed. AI · Software · Product builder. Precise specs. Rigorous audits. Software that holds up in production. Diagram of how I work: agents, spec, build, audit, ship, with audit findings looping back to build. Agents: Claude Code, Google Antigravity. Principles: Specification before code. Audit like an adversary. Evidence over assertion. MYSURU, IN · UTC+5:30 · main · hunainx/hunainx.
